newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TRIPLE P WINS DUTCH ORDER.
newsitem.headline: TRIPLE P WINS DUTCH ORDER.

text.p: Software and automation firm Triple P NV said on Friday it had won an order worth 6.5 million guilders from Dutch publisher Perscombinatie.
Triple P will supply Perscombinatie, the largest Dutch publisher of newspapers, with a new editorial input system.
It said the order was a major breakthrough in the Dutch and European market for newspaper equipment.
Triple P, which is Dutch based and whose shares are listed on the electronic NASDAQ exchange, said in October it would restructure its business to spin off loss-making units.
